name: keyvalet
description: KeyValet — give your AI agents a valet key, not your master key. Plugins for the KeyValet credential broker.

plugins.name: keyvalet
plugins.description: Keeps your keys in KeyValet: stores secrets you share, warns before keys are hard-coded, and adds slash commands (requires the KeyValet MCP server: curl -fsSL https://behalfai.github.io/KeyValet/install.sh | sh).
